english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for prefabricated gypsum boards used on walls and ceilings.

examples.english: The renovation workers said using wallboard for a false ceiling would be much faster.
examples.traditional: 裝修師傅話用石膏板整假天花會快好多。
